This is a breakup/selectivity play rather than assuming all 20 pieces are premium. Conservative U.S. resale is only $80 total (~$4 average per piece), despite recent sold evidence including a vintage Gdansk Poland linen kitchen towel/wall hanging at $24.99 (31 Jan 2026), a vintage lot of 3 embroidered kitchen linens at $10.38 (14 Mar 2026), 2 vintage embroidered linen hand towels at $12.99 (23 Feb 2026), and a Hungarian folk-art embroidered kitchen wall hanging at $35.99 (20 Dec 2025). Prioritize pieces with hand embroidery, folk motifs, Polish/regional text or imagery, strong color, and clean condition; generic machine-made or stained pieces may be low value. Estimated $4 source-side cost is a placeholder for OLX buyer protection/domestic Polish shipping and should be replaced with the actual checkout total before purchase.
